title: THaLLE-ThaiLLM: Domain-Specialized Small LLMs for Finance and Thai – Technical Report
reasoning: The paper evaluates model performance on the ThaiSafetyBench, a benchmark specifically designed to assess model safety by measuring its refusal rate for 'harmful, illegal, sensitive, biased, or ambiguous request[s]'.
